name: Traits
description: Concrete intrinsic creature capabilities and bonuses

fields.name: Amphibious
fields.description: Can breathe and act normally both underwater and on land.

fields.name: Keen Smell
fields.description: +2 to Perception actions when detecting or tracking by scent.

fields.name: Keen Hearing
fields.description: +2 to Perception actions that rely on hearing.

fields.name: Darkvision
fields.description: Cannot be blinded by ordinary darkness.

fields.name: Echolocation
fields.description: Can perceive nearby creatures and obstacles without sight while able to emit and hear sound.

fields.name: Sure-Footed
fields.description: +2 to Dexterity actions made to climb or keep balance on difficult ground.

fields.name: Powerful Build
fields.description: +1 to Strength actions involving pushing, lifting, or breaking objects.

fields.name: Swift Reflexes
fields.description: +1 to Reflexes against threats the creature can perceive.

fields.name: Flight
fields.description: Can fly at its normal movement speed while its wings are free.

fields.name: Gliding
fields.description: Ignores damage from the first 10 meters of a fall and may move 2 meters horizontally per meter descended.

fields.name: Burrower
fields.description: Can move through loose earth at half its normal movement speed and leaves a traversable tunnel.

fields.name: Aquatic Speed
fields.description: Moves through water at its normal movement speed and gains +1 to Dexterity actions made to swim.

fields.name: Regeneration
fields.description: At the start of its turn, recovers 5% of maximum HP if it has at least 1 HP; fire damage prevents this recovery for that turn.

fields.name: Fire Immunity
fields.description: Takes no damage and suffers no harmful effects from ordinary fire or heat.

fields.name: Cold Immunity
fields.description: Takes no damage and suffers no harmful effects from ordinary cold or ice.

fields.name: Poison Immunity
fields.description: Cannot be poisoned and takes no damage from mundane toxins.

fields.name: Disease Immunity
fields.description: Cannot contract or transmit ordinary diseases.

fields.name: Incorporeal
fields.description: Can pass through nonmagical creatures and solid objects at half speed but must end movement in an open space.

fields.name: Natural Camouflage
fields.description: +2 to Dexterity actions made to hide in the creature's native environment.

fields.name: Pack Tactics
fields.description: +1 to attack actions against a target adjacent to one of the creature's allies.

fields.name: Natural Weapons
fields.description: +1 damage with unarmed attacks made using claws, fangs, horns, or another natural weapon.

fields.name: Venomous
fields.description: After a natural attack deals damage, the target loses 1 AP unless it resists the poison.

fields.name: Web Spinner
fields.description: Can create strong restraining webs and gains +2 to Dexterity actions made to move across them.

fields.name: Stone Body
fields.description: Does not need to breathe and gains +2 to Constitution actions made to resist impacts.

fields.name: Magic Sense
fields.description: +2 to Perception actions made to detect active spells or enchanted objects nearby.

fields.name: Pounce
fields.description: +1 to the next action made to grapple or knock a target prone after moving at least 3 meters toward it in the same turn.

fields.name: Charge
fields.description: +1 to the next melee attack after moving at least 5 meters straight toward the target in the same turn.

fields.name: Constrict
fields.description: +2 to Strength actions made to maintain or tighten an existing grapple.

fields.name: Wall Climber
fields.description: Can move along steep or vertical rough surfaces at half its normal movement speed without a routine climbing roll.

fields.name: Tremorsense
fields.description: Detects movement within 10 meters without sight while it and the source are in contact with the same ground.

fields.name: Heat Sense
fields.description: Detects nearby heat sources within 10 meters without sight, though solid barriers block this sense.

fields.name: Prehensile Tail
fields.description: Can hold or manipulate one light object with its tail, but gains no additional action.

fields.name: Powerful Leap
fields.description: +2 to Strength or Dexterity actions made to jump.

fields.name: Swarm Body
fields.description: Can flow through openings large enough for one member and occupy another creature’s space, but remains one creature for actions and effects.

fields.name: Magic Resistance
fields.description: +1 to actions made to resist hostile magical effects.

fields.name: Extended Reach
fields.description: Can make ordinary close attacks from up to 2 meters farther away than a similar-sized creature.
